title: CIA-UAP-D001, Intelligence Information Report, USSR, 1973
doc_notes: This document is a CIA intelligence information report regarding the Sary Shagan Weapons Testing Range in the USSR, containing a single UAP sighting report in section 14.

incidents.summary: Source observed a bright green circular object that formed concentric circles before dissipating.
incidents.location_name: Site 7, Sary Shagan Weapons Testing Range
incidents.quote: observed an unidentified sharp (bright) green circular object or mass in the sky
